{
 "path": "programs/task-1802081e.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_cuts = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_ranges = [(row_cuts[i] + 1, row_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_cuts) - 1) if row_cuts[i] + 1 < row_cuts[i + 1]]
    col_ranges = [(col_cuts[i] + 1, col_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_cuts) - 1) if col_cuts[i] + 1 < col_cuts[i + 1]]
    separators = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker_colors = [color for color, n in counts.items() if color != background and color not in separators]
    marker = marker_colors[0] if marker_colors else None
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_ranges:
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in col_ranges:
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) if marker is not None else 0
            line.append(1 if n >= 2 else background)
        out.append(line)
    return out
"
}
